for item in gi.histories.show_history(seed, contents=True):
    if item.get('deleted') or item.get('purged'):
        continue
    src='hdca' if item.get('history_content_type')=='dataset_collection' else 'hda'
    gi.histories.copy_content(h['id'], item['id'], source=src)
print(h['id'])
PY"
